location_description:
Oscoda Charter Township is a charter township of Iosco County in the U.S. state of Michigan.  The population was 7,248 at the 2000 census.


== Communities ==
Oscoda is an unincorporated community and census-designated place located on the northern side of the Au Sable River where it enters Lake Huron.
